prompts.sleeping_dragon: Mon dieu, look! A dragon is asleep across the bridge, and it snores like a train. We can't wait here all day. Tell me in French how we get across without waking it.
prompts.talking_goat: Zut, a goat is standing in the middle of the ford, and it says it only lets French speakers pass. It looks very serious about this. Tell it about your day, in French, so it lets us through.
prompts.giant_snail: Sacrebleu! A snail the size of a cart is sliding down the road, very, very slowly. At this speed we arrive next year. Tell me in French how we get past it.
prompts.ghost_baker: Tiens! The bakery at the crossroads is open, but the baker is a ghost. The croissants smell real, at least. Order our breakfast in French: what do you want, and how many?
prompts.lost_knight: Oh là là, a knight in rusty armor is sitting by the road, and he is completely lost. He asks where we are going. Tell him in French where we are going and why.
prompts.floating_castle: Regarde! A castle is floating over the field, with a flag on every tower, and it is drifting away. Describe it in French before it is gone: its color, its size, who lives there.
prompts.fox_in_a_hat: Ah bon? A fox in a tall hat steps out of the bushes and bows. It wants to know who we are. Tell it three things about yourself in French.
prompts.singing_well: Écoute! The old well by the road is singing, and the song is a little sad. I can't understand the words. Tell me in French what you think it sings about.
